category: hosted model inference with monthly token plans
tier: Free promotion ended; paid 30-day token plans: Lite, Essential, Pro

free_tier.stated: unverified: the free Qwen3.8-27B promotion has ended and no current free allowance is published; retained monthly Auto allowances apply only where completed top-ups before the promotion ended remain positive after refunds

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is model tokens, not stored objects; an Auto request allows up to 128,000 output tokens in a 1,000,000-token context window

retention.stated: unused Auto tokens from a plan period expire when the next period starts; inference inputs are retained only as necessary for the stated processing purposes

egress.terms: the API response is the payload; no separate egress allowance or traffic price is published on the pricing or docs pages

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses at https://api.iteracompute.com/v1; the tier is gated on an API key
tooling: the OpenAI SDK or any HTTP client, pointed at https://api.iteracompute.com/v1 with a key minted in the console
chaining: a key works across the listed models and coding agents through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint; unused Auto tokens expire at the period boundary, so jobs that need them should run within one 30-day period

limits.value: Lite $10 per 30 days with 100M extra Auto tokens; Essential $20 per 30 days with 200M extra Auto tokens; Pro $50 per 30 days with 500M extra Auto tokens
429 is returned for a monthly allowance limit or provider capacity; follow Retry-After and use exponential backoff

limits_note: cash overage uses published per-model retail prices; plan and billing terms are finalised at checkout
binding_note: the paid plans are denominated in 30-day periods with a fixed Auto token allowance, which runs out before an undisclosed provider-capacity rate for sustained use

identity_cost.detail: register and verify an email address or sign in with Google; the signup form asks for an email and a password of at least 12 characters and accepts the service agreement

reliability_note: Auto selects a model from spare capacity using current demand and cost, so the serving model can change between requests; 429 with free_model_monthly_limit or provider_rate_limit is documented
